root_text:
Symptoms of HMPV:

Common: Cough, fever, sore throat, runny nose

Severe: Wheezing, shortness of breath, pneumonia
Spread via droplets, close contact, or contaminated surfaces. Basic hygiene is key! 🧼 #HealthTips
